description: This file is a shell script containing a series of test cases for verifying the behavior of the 'git reset' command with various options. It includes test setup, execution, and validation steps using a testing library 'test-lib.sh', and performs operations such as creating commits, branching, merging, and resetting Git repositories to check correctness.
